subject: MAP: benchmark exports, dashboard links, and exec readout scheduling
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@stellarhealth.com>, procurement@stellarhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: MAP: benchmark exports, dashboard links, and exec readout scheduling

Alex / Procurement team —

As discussed on the call, attached is the initial plan for packaging the MAP performance artifacts you requested. High level: we will produce per-model CSV exports, a concise executive slide deck, and a live dashboard snapshot for your exec readout. Below are the metrics we will include and the proposed filenames: 

Key metrics (per workload/model variant):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 (ms) for inference (token-level)
- Throughput: tokens/sec and requests/sec under target concurrency
- TTFT (time-to-first-token): median and 90th percentile
- Concurrency: sustained throughput at 1, 8, 16, 32 concurrent connections
- Failure/Error rates and retries (5xx, timeouts)

Proposed exports (delivery tomorrow EOD):
- SH_MAP_Benchmark_Results_v1.csv (separate rows per model/config; includes raw sample IDs and query types)
- SH_MAP_Executive_Readout_Deck_v1.pptx (3 slides: TL;DR, key metrics, operational recommendations)
- Perf_Dashboard_Snapshot_20270630.png (Grafana panel snapshots with filters for your workloads)

Temporary links for review:
- Console report: https://redwood.console/reports/SH-2027-06-PR-78
- Grafana: https://grafana.internal.redwood/boards/perf-stellarhealth
- CSV (S3): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-temp/SH/benchmarks/SH_MAP_Benchmark_v1.csv

Ask: can you confirm attendees for the executive readout next week (CE decision-maker + procurement negotiator)? Once I have names, we will tailor one slide to the commercial ask (latency SLO and expected capacity).

One operational note: the CSV will contain sample-level latency traces; if you want an aggregated-only artifact (no raw traces) for legal, tell me and we’ll redact before final delivery.

Thanks — sending the first-pass CSV and deck by EOD tomorrow (June 29 PDT).

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0124

[Attachment: MAP_Benchmark_Plan_v0.1.txt (text)]

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@stellarhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stellarhealth.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: benchmark exports, dashboard links, and exec readout scheduling

Thanks Hannah — this looks good and in line with what our CTO asked for. A few quick points: 

- Please ensure the CSV is split by model + quantization profile; our infra team evaluates both separately.
- For the exec readout, attendees will be:
  - Priya Rao, VP Engineering (decision-maker)
  - Mark Ellison, Head of Procurement
  - Myself (technical sponsor)

Mark will want a single slide that maps performance to cost (tokens/sec vs estimated $/1M tokens).

Also: can you add a short appendix in the deck listing test harness parameters (sequence lengths, prompt mix, warmup policy)? That will make it easier for our infra folks to reproduce.

We received the temporary S3 link and Grafana link — will review and circle back with comments by EOD tomorrow.

Alex
Alex Nguyen
Software Engineering Manager, Platform
StellarHealth
alex.nguyen@stellarhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 18:24:00 +0000
Subject: Re: internal: MAP export ops and CSV conventions

Hannah / Marissa — internal ops notes for the delivery: 

1) CSV conventions
- File: SH_MAP_Benchmark_Results_v1.csv (header rows included)
- Columns: model_id, quant_profile, prompt_type, seq_len, concurrency_level, request_id, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, ttft_ms, tokens_per_request, errors, retries
- We will also include a sha256 checksum file: SH_MAP_Benchmark_Results_v1.csv.sha256

2) Aggregation and privacy
- Produce two variants: raw-traces (for infra) and agg-only (for legal/procurement). Filenames: *_raw.csv and *_agg.csv. The agg version will contain only aggregated percentiles and no raw request_id rows.

3) Dashboard filters
- Default Grafana link will point to: environment=prod, model_family=redwood-open, prompt_mix=clinical-summary. We will include instructions to change filters for other workloads.

4) Exec deck appendix
- Add a short slide showing test harness parameters (warmup tokens=1024, sample size=500 per model, prompt mix: 60% short, 40% long).

5) Delivery and timeline
- EOD Wed (2027-06-30) final artifacts uploaded to S3 and HubSpot attachment added to deal. I will generate the CSVs and checksum early Wed morning and hand to Hannah for final review.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

[Attachment: internal_export_checklist.md]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 22:04:00 +0000
Subject: Delivered: final MAP benchmark exports, dashboard snapshot, and exec readout time

Alex / Team —

Delivery: all final artifacts are uploaded and attached per the MAP checklist. Summary below: 

Delivered artifacts:
- SH_MAP_Benchmark_Results_v1_raw.csv (S3): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-temp/SH/benchmarks/SH_MAP_Benchmark_Results_v1_raw.csv
- SH_MAP_Benchmark_Results_v1_agg.csv (S3): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-temp/SH/benchmarks/SH_MAP_Benchmark_Results_v1_agg.csv
- SH_MAP_Executive_Readout_Deck_v1.pptx (HubSpot attachment on deal)
- Perf_Dashboard_Snapshot_20270630.png (attached)
- Checksums: SH_MAP_Benchmark_Results_v1_raw.csv.sha256

Highlights (TL;DR):
- p95 latency across the primary model at 2k tokens: 312 ms (concurrency=8), p99=560 ms
- TTFT median: 34 ms; 90th percentile: 110 ms
- Sustained throughput at concurrency=16: 1,800 tokens/sec (aggregate)
- Error rate across runs: 0.2% (retries primarily due to transient infra limits during burst testing)

Next steps / asks:
- Please confirm whether you want the agg-only artifacts shared with your legal/procurement (we will keep raw traces restricted).
- Executive readout: proposed slot Thurs 7/8 10:30am PT (30 min) — Priya + Mark + Alex on your side? We will include the single slide mapping perf->cost as requested.
- Procurement: once the readout is complete and any SLO language agreed, please share the PO to route to finance. Deal ticket: SH-2027-06-PR-78.

Attached to this message: Perf_Dashboard_Snapshot_20270630.png, SH_MAP_Executive_Readout_Deck_v1.pptx

If you want a 1:1 demo of the Grafana filters I used, Ben can walk the infra team through the reproducibility steps.

Thanks — looking forward to the readout.

Warmly,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0124
